## Researcher / Research Group

Name, laboratory, institution, or independent research group.

## Primary Discipline

## Architectural Role

## Research Question

Theory / formalization / implementation / benchmark / experiment / dataset / validation / critique / documentation.

## Interfaces

## Required Evidence
